This multi-scenario adventure tells the story of Kirimiya Shou and the troubles he faces as he finds his heart drawn to two sisters during his last summer vacation as a student.

It's a true-to-life story of a young man feeling guilt towards a forbidden love, and yet unable to suppress his desires.
